items.title: Detect stale verificationEvidence at user-visible entry points
items.context: session_brief, story_advance pre-check (REVIEW/TEST/DONE), and koala validate output must compare current materialHash / headHash with stored evidence and flag stale rows explicitly. The flag must read as 'EVIDENCE STALE (materialHash drift after <sha>)' rather than a generic validation failure. Reuse existing freshness check, do not re-implement.
items.userSees: User runs `koala session_brief` after merging main; in the brief output a new block appears: `⚠ EVIDENCE STALE (materialHash drift after eccd3758): 3 verification intent(s) stale for B-a2f1`. Same block appears in `koala story_advance --phase=TEST/DONE` pre-check output and `koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json` text output when stale state is detected.

happy.desc: After mutating a material source file referenced by stored evidence, koala session_brief output for B-a2f1 contains the literal string EVIDENCE STALE and a storyId-bearing recovery line
After the same mutation, koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json textOutput contains EVIDENCE STALE marker (replacing the older generic stale hint)
After the same mutation, story_advance --phase=TEST pre-check rejects with output containing EVIDENCE STALE marker

edge.desc: When evidence is fresh (no materialHash drift), none of the three surfaces print EVIDENCE STALE
When only koala_metadata-only changes happened after evidence (legacy fresh case), surfaces stay quiet — they do not falsely flag stale

adversarial.desc: Surfaces never print EVIDENCE STALE without also printing a copy-paste recovery line including the actual storyId

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts session_brief output for stale fixture contains EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER + storyId recovery line
Smoke asserts koala validate text output for stale fixture contains EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER
Smoke asserts story_advance pre-check for stale fixture contains EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER
Smoke fresh-fixture assertion: none of three surfaces print EVIDENCE STALE when materialHash matches
Smoke metadata-only-change case: surfaces stay quiet, treating metadata-only commits as fresh per checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit
Smoke asserts every surface that prints EVIDENCE_STALE_MARKER also includes copy-paste recovery line with actual storyId

items.title: Print copy-paste recovery commands in stale-evidence output
items.context: Every stale flag must be followed by the exact CLI lines that resolve it for this story: e.g., 'koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-xxx' then 'koala validate --story=B-xxx --json'. Lines must use the actual storyId, not placeholders, so users copy and run without editing. Output goes into session_brief footer, story_advance hint surface, and koala validate trailing block.
items.userSees:
Immediately after the EVIDENCE STALE marker line, user sees a literal block:
  Run to recover:
    koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-a2f1
    koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json
The storyId in both lines is the actual story ID (B-a2f1), not a placeholder, so the user copies-and-runs without editing.

happy.desc: Output below EVIDENCE STALE marker contains the literal koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-a2f1 line
Same block also contains koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json line on the following line

edge.desc: All three surfaces (session_brief, story_advance pre-check, koala validate) print byte-identical recovery block to avoid users having to recognize multiple formats

adversarial.desc: Output never contains the literal placeholder strings <storyId> or <B- when stale state is detected — only the actual storyId is interpolated
If story has no storyId context (edge: cross-story session_brief), the recovery block is omitted entirely rather than printing a placeholder

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts recovery block contains literal 'koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=<actual-id>' line
Smoke asserts recovery block contains literal 'koala validate --story=<actual-id> --json' line directly after refresh line
Smoke asserts pairwise byte-identical recovery blocks across session_brief, story_advance, koala validate surfaces
Smoke asserts output never contains placeholder strings '<storyId>' or '<B-' (preMortem #3 anchor)
Smoke asserts no-storyId case: renderEvidenceStaleHint omits block entirely instead of printing placeholders

items.title: Add a single-shot recover command that does refresh + revalidate
items.context: Provide 'koala recover_evidence --storyId=B-xxx' (or accept an existing entry point name) that runs verification_evidence_refresh_stale then validate in one go, prints both transcripts, and exits non-zero if validate still fails. The command must refuse to run if there are non-koala_metadata dirty files (material/fixture/unexpected) so it cannot mask real drift.
items.userSees: User runs `koala recover_evidence --storyId=B-a2f1`. The command prints first the refresh transcript (`✓ refreshed N verification evidence entries`) then the validate transcript (`koala validate --story=B-a2f1 --json` output). Exits 0 if validate passes after refresh. Exits non-zero with explicit message `recover_evidence refused: material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files present, run git status to inspect` when classifier flags non-koala_metadata dirt.

happy.desc: koala recover_evidence --storyId=B-a2f1 runs verification_evidence_refresh_stale then validate, prints both transcripts in order, exits 0 when validate passes

edge.desc: recover_evidence exits non-zero with a refused message when material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files exist (uses B-6326 DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES classifier)
recover_evidence proceeds normally when only koala_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes are present in worktree

adversarial.desc: recover_evidence refuse-list uses an allowlist (koala_metadata + runtime + declared_artifact) so any future DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES addition defaults to refuse — no silent loosening
recover_evidence does not auto-recover without storyId; missing storyId arg returns explicit error

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke happy: recover_evidence runs refresh + validate, returns status=pass with both transcripts
Smoke refuse: recover_evidence with unexpected_dirty_files returns status=refused, refused.categories contains unexpected_dirty_files
Smoke happy includes worktree with allowed dirty categories (koala_metadata) — recover_evidence proceeds normally
Smoke allowlist-invariant assertion: RECOVER_EVIDENCE_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES is exactly {koala_metadata_changes, runtime_artifact_changes, declared_artifact_changes} — proves allowlist not blocklist
Smoke asserts recover_evidence with missing/empty storyId throws runtime error (Zod + handler double-layer per CLAUDE.md handler-encoding-convention)

items.title: Regression-prove the stale UX with a simulated main-merge scenario
items.context: Add a smoke test that writes verificationEvidence, mutates a referenced material source file to break materialHash, then asserts: session_brief output, story_advance output, and koala validate output all contain the literal 'EVIDENCE STALE' marker followed by a copy-paste line including the storyId; recover_evidence command refreshes the evidence and revalidate passes; recover_evidence refuses when an unexpected_dirty_files path exists.
items.userSees: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:evidence-recovery-smoke` (or equivalent task wiring) prints `✓ evidence-recovery smoke passed` and asserts: stale-fixture worktree triggers EVIDENCE STALE marker on session_brief / story_advance / validate; recover_evidence refreshes and revalidate passes; recover_evidence refuses on unexpected_dirty_files fixture.

happy.desc: Smoke fixture mutates a tracked material source path under a temp worktree, writes evidence with stale materialHash, asserts session_brief / story_advance / validate all produce EVIDENCE STALE marker with copy-paste storyId line
Smoke runs recover_evidence and asserts second validate is fresh + passes

edge.desc: Smoke adds an unexpected_dirty_files path (e.g. packages/main/tests/output/x.json) to the same worktree and asserts recover_evidence refuses with non-zero exit and refused message

adversarial.desc: Smoke confirms surfaces produce byte-identical EVIDENCE STALE block (same marker, same recovery block) across session_brief / story_advance / validate
Smoke confirms recovery block never contains placeholder text when storyId is present

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke simulated-main-merge block: temp git fixture mutates material file then asserts all three surfaces emit EVIDENCE STALE marker with storyId-bearing copy-paste line
Smoke calls recover_evidence on stale fixture and asserts revalidate passes + findStaleEvidence returns empty after
Smoke adds packages/main/tests/output/foo.json unexpected_dirty_files path then asserts recover_evidence returns status=refused with non-zero exit and refused message
Smoke main-merge regression asserts byte-identical recovery block across session_brief / story_advance / koala validate surfaces
